messages:
sam: quick note — ran a focused sweep on Mixtral-8B and Qwen-7B focusing on kernel selection vs batch heuristics this morning. results look noisy when context > 8k tokens.
maria: can you paste the key numbers? interested in latency P95 and throughput dropoffs.
sam: sure. short summary: Mixtral-8B on kernel_x gives best throughput up to 2k ctx. beyond that kernel_y wins for latency. Qwen-7B prefers kernel_z for short ctx but kernel_y becomes better at longctx when kv cache hit rate is high.
sam: measured on p4d, profiles include continuous batching enabled, default kv cache policy.

sam: numbers (tokens/sec, P95 ms) — batch_size=16 single-device:
- Mixtral-8B kernel_x: 4200 t/s, P95 72ms
- Mixtral-8B kernel_y: 3600 t/s, P95 68ms (better latency at long ctx)
- Qwen-7B kernel_z: 4800 t/s, P95 65ms
- Qwen-7B kernel_y: 4100 t/s, P95 70ms

maria: interesting that kernel_y has lower P95 despite lower t/s for Mixtral. could be due to reduced tail-jitter from kv memory layout.
devon: saw a regression in staging yesterday where enabling fractional RoPE scaling bumped kv cache evictions. was that related?
sam: yes — when we enabled RoPE fractional scale 0.7 for Mixtral to reduce positional aliasing, eviction rate jumped ~12% at batch_size >= 24. profiler shows KV allocation churn in the allocator.

sam: stack trace snippet from perf collector:
```
kv_cache_evict: allocator::release_range+0x1f
batcher::flush_window+0x4c
kernel_y::dispatch_forward+0xa3
```

maria: that explains meter increase. any mitigation tests?
sam: tested two mitigations:
- reduce max_batch_tokens from 8192 -> 4096 for longctx workloads (drops evictions, P95 improves)
- set kv_evict_threshold to 0.8 (was 0.95) which keeps working set resident and avoids thrashing but increases memory footprint ~6%

devon: what about head/kv dim interactions? we saw Qwen head dim mismatch causing suboptimal kernel path selection.
sam: right — Qwen-7B uses 128 head-dim per head; our kernel selector wrongly matched Mixtral-8B heuristics for some layer shapes. fix: add rule: if head_dim % 64 != 0, prefer kernel_z for better vectorization. also prefer kernel_y when kv_dim >= 12288.

maria: final config recommendations from this sweep:
- Mixtral-8B: use kernel_x for short ctx (<2k) with batch_size_device <= 16; switch to kernel_y for ctx >=2k. enable fractional RoPE only when kv_evict_threshold lowered and max_batch_tokens capped at 4096.
- Qwen-7B: prefer kernel_z for most short/medium ctx; kernel_y for longctx when kv_hit_rate > 0.85. set dynamic_batcher.max_batch_tokens=4096, batch_timeout_ms=12.
- Global: set kv_evict_threshold=0.8 for longctx-heavy fleets; add head_dim heuristic to kernel selector.

perf-bot: experiment created: exp/mtl-qwen-rope-186824 (links: https://perf.redwood/exp/186824) :thumbsup:

devon: copying these to runtime-config PR and will flag onboarding note for customers using >8k contexts.
maria: thanks — can you add a short reproducer (small script) so SRE can validate with our emu? otherwise looks actionable.
sam: will attach repro + perf csv to the PR today.
